title: Statistician — Time-Series Insights Writer (AI Training)
description:
We’re seeking Statisticians with strong English writing skills to join our Deep Research for Forecasting project. In this role, you will review time-series plots (a quantity of interest over time) along with brief contextual descriptions, then identify the most meaningful patterns in the data and produce concise, well-reasoned causal chains explaining what likely drove those patterns.

Your work will help create high-quality tasks used to train and evaluate AI systems on forecasting-related reasoning. You will focus on distinguishing signal from noise, articulating plausible mechanisms (root cause → intermediate drivers → observed time-series impact), and writing explanations that are clear, grounded, and useful for downstream model training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create Forecasting Training Tasks: Given a time-series plot and short description, identify the most important patterns (trend, seasonality, regime changes, outliers, step changes, cyclical behavior, variance shifts) and document them clearly.
  • Write Causal Chains: Produce concise causal narratives that explain patterns from root cause → mechanism → observable time-series effect, prioritizing the most meaningful drivers and avoiding generic explanations.
  • Ensure Clarity & Usefulness for AI Training: Write structured, high-signal explanations that are easy to evaluate, minimizing ambiguity and making assumptions explicit when necessary.
  • Maintain Consistency & Quality: Follow project guidelines and rubrics to ensure outputs are accurate, coherent, and comparable across many examples.
  • Weekly Commitment: 10 hours/week

Your Profile

  • You have an educational and/or professional background in Statistics or a closely related field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science).
  • Proficient in time-series analysis and forecasting (e.g., trend/seasonality, structural breaks, anomalies, volatility shifts, lag effects).
  • Excellent English writing skills with a clear, structured, concise style.
  • Strong analytical judgment and ability to interpret data visualizations with precision.
  • Comfortable forming plausible causal explanations while clearly separating evidence from assumptions.
  • Optional: Domain knowledge in one or more of the following: Healthcare; Climate/oceanography; Economics & finance; Cloud operations; Transportation.

As an ACES Process Manager, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) at Amazon Logistics (AMZL). We are Amazon's last mile delivery arm, delivering packages and smiles to our customers every day.

You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.

  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.

  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.

title: Reliability & Rotating Equipment Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocatio[...]
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a reliability/rotating equipment engineer to join the North Ghawar Maintenance Division (NGMD) / Reliability Unit (RU) of the North Ghawar Producing Department (NGPD).

The RU's scope includes condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis to identify and mitigate potential equipment failures. By leveraging these services, the RU aims to optimize rotating equipment reliability, reduce maintenance costs, and improve overall asset efficiency.

Your primary role is to provide proactive maintenance support, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, and overseeing rotating equipment overhaul activities to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimize downtime.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Oversee and perform Product Data Management (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis, to identify potential equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and implement condition-based maintenance programs to optimize equipment performance and minimize downtime.
  • Develop and implement reliability-centered maintenance programs to identify and prioritize maintenance activities based on equipment reliability and criticality.
  • Perform failure analysis on equipment to identify root causes of failures and recommend corrective actions to prevent repeat failures.
  • Perform technical evaluations of new equipment to ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, and to identify potential reliability and maintenance issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and codes, such as American Petroleum Institute (API), American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), and American Society for Testing and Materials ASTM, for rotating equipment and reliability engineering.
  • Prepare technical reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders, including management and operations teams.
  • Perform oil analysis and other predictive maintenance tests to identify potential equipment problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Perform diagnostics on rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, and gearboxes, to identify potential problems and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain Reliability Unit KPIs such as maintenance cost reduction, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR).

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 15 years of experience in reliability/rotating equipment engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of reliability, including rotating equipment reliability, Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Familiarity with rotating equipment diagnostics such as vibration analysis, oil analysis, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Hold a vibration analyst certificate Cat‑III.
  • Understand industry standards and codes related to reliability, such as API, ASME, and ASTM.
  • Practical experience in reliability engineering or a related field, preferably in the oil and gas industry.
  • Effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness of the latest advancements in reliability science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.
  • Knowledge of rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal Systems, and gearboxes.
  • Experience with Predictive Maintenance (PDM) services, such as vibration analysis and oil analysis.
  • Familiarity with condition-based maintenance, reliability-centered maintenance, and failure analysis.
  • Ability to perform and aid in technical evaluations of new equipment.

description:
About the job Did you know Hopper's technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform drives travel purchases for major global brands — from banks to airlines to fintech leaders. This platform is essentially a configurable, multi-tenant travel commerce engine, enabling partners to launch world-class hotel and travel booking experiences faster, with less custom engineering.

We’re looking for a senior software engineer who has adopted the best practices in terms of AI-assisted coding. You are not using AI to auto-complete your code; you are using multiple agents to autonomously deliver features at a speed that was impossible a few months ago. You understand well the strengths and weaknesses of LLMs, and you know how to build a feedback loop and guardrails to get the best out of them.

Tech stack

  • Backend systems are written in Scala, and we use a suite of GCP services
  • Frontends are web apps using react + typescript

What your day-to-day would look like

  • Identify and execute improvements to the code base to allow agents to go faster and safer.
  • Work with a group of top-tier engineers in a low-process environment powered by trust and high autonomy.
  • Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously by leveraging AI to author the thoughtful documentation and specifications that guide the team.
  • Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Orchestrate AI agents to build new features from top to bottom, from UX to database, with minimal oversight.
  • Architect the scalable solutions and foundational patterns that allow us to efficiently launch new portals.
  • Work directly with PMs and business partners to define and refine our roadmap; your voice and technical vision matter.
  • Collaborate with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving the high-level feedback necessary for growth.

An ideal candidate has

  • A natural drive to fearlessly deep dive into an unknown code base while keeping their eyes on the goal to deliver results fast.
  • Proven ability to direct AI agents and automated workflows to architect, implement, and maintain complex software systems with minimal human intervention.
  • Expertise in designing the technical guardrails and automated feedback loops that maximize the productivity and reliability of AI agents operating within the codebase.
  • Strong product thinking where your conception of quality and architecture is inherently anchored in the customer experience.
  • Experience with, or a mastery-level willingness to learn, distributed system development in Scala.

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. the Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Garantir o funcionamento eficiente e contínuo dos sistemas de refrigeração e climatização por meio da execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas, assegurando o conforto térmico e a integridade dos equipamentos, alinhado às normas de segurança e sustentabilidade.

title: Global Head of Cloud Alliances

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.

Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go‑to‑market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.

Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell‑to, sell‑through and sell‑with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud‑related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.

Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.

  • Taking ownership of Canonical’s global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross‑functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution

  • Establishing and nurturing executive‑level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long‑term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

What We Are Looking For In You

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject

  • Track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data‑driven narratives

  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in‑depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results

Nice to Have

  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.

What We Offer Colleagues

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS

Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL). É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós clicando aqui.

Sobre a Posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de TI Sênior com forte visão funcional e técnica, capaz de atuar como protagonista na conexão entre áreas de negócio e fornecedores de tecnologia. Esse profissional terá papel estratégico na definição de soluções, transformando necessidades dos usuários em entregas tecnológicas assertivas, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Na posição, você será responsável por apoiar decisões de arquitetura, participar ativamente na evolução das plataformas corporativas e contribuir para o sucesso dos projetos executados com fornecedores parceiros. Buscamos alguém com excelente capacidade de comunicação, domínio técnico para dialogar com desenvolvedores e visão analítica para apoiar o negócio com clareza e precisão. Se você gosta de desafios, deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborar diretamente para a melhoria contínua de sistemas críticos, essa oportunidade é para você.

Como Será Seu Dia a Dia

  • Realizar o desdobramento dos requisitos funcionais em documentação técnica clara e completa.
  • Atuar lado a lado com desenvolvedores de API (Java) e SalesForce, propondo soluções de arquitetura orientadas à escalabilidade, resiliência e performance.
  • Discutir arquitetura de solução com áreas cross (Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Dados e Infraestrutura).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento executado por fornecedores, garantindo aderência às especificações e aos requisitos não funcionais.
  • Questionar e orientar arquiteturas de software, propondo melhorias quando necessário.
  • Participar de diagnósticos de falhas, consultando dados nos diversos bancos de dados (postgres, sqlserver, Oracle), engajar os times necessários e conduzir análises de causa raiz.
  • Apoiar a evolução da plataforma e propor correções ou melhorias contínuas.
  • Aprofundar-se no conhecimento funcional dos sistemas sob sua responsabilidade para atuar como referência nas fases de QA interno e UAT.
  • Auxiliar usuários no diagnóstico de falhas em produção, suporte a incidentes e problemas.
  • Atuar como líder técnico nos projetos, servindo como referência para o planejamento junto com o gerente do projeto e os fornecedores.

Do Que Você Precisa

  • Experiência sólida em análise funcional e técnica.
  • Bagagem técnica em desenvolvimento, especialmente para atuar com APIs em Java, avaliando soluções e discutindo detalhes técnicos com desenvolvedores.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de arquitetura de software (escalabilidade, resiliência, performance, observabilidade, segurança).
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e processos associados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramenta de gestão de trabalho (Jira).
  • Experiência em projetos que envolvem múltiplos fornecedores e áreas internas.

description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Construir relatórios analíticos e painéis complexos para stakeholders e alta liderança, garantindo clareza e objetividade na apresentação dos resultados;
  • Atuar de forma autônoma na condução de análises e demandas da área, com agilidade e assertividade nas entregas;
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos em linguagem acessível para públicos não técnicos, facilitando a tomada de decisão;
  • Responder de forma rápida a solicitações e emergências analíticas, atuando como apoio estratégico entre diferentes áreas do negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Power BI avançado, com domínio de DAX em nível avançado;
  • SQL avançado, com capacidade de estruturar e manipular grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento em Python e Power Automate será um diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, com senso crítico, curiosidade e inquietação para aprofundar análises e solucionar demandas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com independência e organização, mantendo postura tranquila mesmo sob pressão;
  • Proatividade para buscar informações e construir entregas de forma autônoma;
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes áreas e traduzir dados em insights estratégicos.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Gympass - Acesso a academias e demais atividades de bem-estar;
  • Auxilio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

#Rio

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 25.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

******TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO ELEGÍVEIS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA E REABILITADOS INSS.******

RESPONSÁIVAS DESTE CARGO

  • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;

  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;
  • Comparecer em audiência como prepostos, representando a empresa, em processos judiciais e administrativos, caso haja requisição do departamento jurídico;
  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

Comunica ideias e conceitos de forma clara e eficaz, conduzindo fóruns de lições aprendidas tanto internamente quanto com o cliente.

Sólida compreensão dos sistemas de Qualidade, processos e ferramentas da área, com habilidade para apoiar colegas e resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização.   • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;

  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Data Engineer (Senior) ID54349
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Data Engineer , you will drive the measurement and optimization of employee engagement across internal communication channels, shaping how data informs messaging and strategy. Partnering closely with the Platforms team, you’ll design GA4 tracking, build dashboards in Looker Studio or Tableau, and transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that enhance reach, relevance, and impact across email, intranet, Slack, video, and other channels. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence internal communications through analytics while working at the intersection of data engineering, digital platforms, and employee engagement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and maintain the measurement framework for Employee Communications, including KPIs, north-star metrics, and leading indicators;
  • Implement and QA GA4 tracking for internal websites, newsletters, and campaign landing pages;
  • Build automated dashboards and self-serve reporting in Looker Studio or Tableau for stakeholders at different levels;
  • Analyze traffic, engagement, and content performance across communication channels;
  • Segment performance by audience, geography, organization, device, and channel to identify drivers of awareness and action;
  • Run experiments and A/B tests on content, timing, and channel mix; measure results and recommend optimizations;
  • Develop attribution approaches for internal campaigns;
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and documentation, including event taxonomies, UTM standards, metadata conventions, and metric definitions;
  • Collaborate on campaign execution by supporting targeted list pulls and data segmentation to improve message relevance and engagement rates;
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to support leadership requests and quarterly or annual business reviews;
  • Translate analytical findings into clear narratives and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience in digital, marketing, or product analytics, or similar analytical roles;
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and joining datasets across multiple data sources;
  • Hands‑on experience with Google Analytics 4, including events, parameters, custom dimensions/metrics, conversions, and explorations;
  • Experience implementing and validating analytics tracking frameworks, including tagging plans, UTM standards, and metadata governance;
  • Advanced experience building dashboards in Looker Studio and/or Tableau, including data modeling, calculated fields, filters, and interactive visualizations;
  • Strong data modeling and data preparation skills;
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations;
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences;
  • Experience analyzing engagement and performance metrics across digital channels;
  • Familiarity with survey analytics (e.g., pulse surveys, eNPS) and combining behavioral and attitudinal data;
  • Exposure to analytics for employee communications platforms (e.g., intranet, email platforms, internal messaging tools);
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience designing advanced data visualizations in Tableau;
  • Experience with Python for exploratory analysis or data manipulation.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Objetivo Do Cargo

Atuar como agente de transformação, liderando iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital que impulsionem a competitividade, a eficiência operacional e a experiência do cliente. Esta posição tem como propósito fortalecer uma cultura de inovação contínua, conectando tendências emergentes às necessidades estratégicas da Supergasbras e promovendo soluções que gerem valor sustentável para o negócio .

  • Capacitação e Disseminação de Conhecimento: Conduzir workshops, treinamentos e outras ações de capacitação para disseminar metodologias de inovação e fomentar o pensamento criativo em toda a organização.

  • Experiencia na área;
  • Conhecimentos do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês avançado

Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração. What’s The Role

  • Technology Theme Development and Assessment
  • Oversight and management of budget expenditure for projects delivered under his/her responsibility, guaranteeing the Levy compliance.
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify key technology themes of strategic importance to the Carbon and Biofuel business and which can be developed through externally funded R&D projects.

  • General
  • Maintain surveillance of the wider technology arena, and track developments, competitor and supplier activity with potential relevance to the Low‑Carbon Tech agenda: attend relevant industry conferences, develop networks of contacts etc.
  • Communicate effectively at all levels, both internally and externally: share knowledge with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Ecology, Agronomy and related areas (MSc degree is desirable)
  • 3+ years of experience in related field
  • Solid knowledge in Project Management
  • Technical and analytical knowledge in research and development, particularly in carbon projects and Life Cycle Analysis
  • The ability to work productively with a range of personnel and disciplines, both within Technical and the business and both technical and non‑technical
  • Fluent in both written and spoken Portuguese and English is essential
  • Good interpersonal and relationship building skills, with the ability to interact effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Must be a good written and verbal communicator, able to present and summarise issues concisely
  • Must be a clear thinker, able to assimilate and analyse a wide range of information and generate pragmatic solutions
  • Ability to influence key internal and external stakeholders

What We Offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

title: Analista de Dados  (BI & Insights)
description:
Quem somos

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas a vendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Dados com perfil analítico e consultivo, capaz de transformar dados em insights acionáveis e em histórias claras e relevantes para clientes.

Essa pessoa terá papel central na leitura de resultados de campanhas, construção de análises em BI e desenvolvimento de materiais visuais que apoiem decisões, mostrem valor e aumentem o engajamento dos clientes com a estratégia da Incentive.me. Mais do que “operar dados”, queremos alguém que saiba interpretar contexto, identificar padrões, gerar recomendações e comunicar bem. Possibilidade de crescimento para coordenador se atender às expectativas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar bases de dados de campanhas e programas de incentivo para identificar padrões, oportunidades, desvios e alavancas de resultado.
  • Transformar dados em insights claros e acionáveis, com foco em performance comercial e comportamento da força de vendas.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards e visuais em ferramentas de BI (Power BI).
  • Interpretar indicadores e métricas de negócio (ex.: adesão, engajamento, performance, conversão, CAV, ROP, etc.) e traduzir isso em recomendações práticas.
  • Criar narrativas analíticas (“data storytelling”) para apresentações, relatórios executivos e reuniões com clientes.
  • Apoiar times internos (atendimento, community, operação e estratégia) com análises que direcionem decisões e priorizações.
  • Garantir consistência e qualidade das análises, validando dados e sinalizando possíveis inconsistências.
  • Estruturar relatórios recorrentes e análises para acompanhamento de campanhas.
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes quando necessário, ajudando a explicar resultados e responder dúvidas com segurança analítica.
  • Documentar principais métricas, premissas e leituras para dar escala e consistência às análises.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com análise de dados aplicada a negócio (BI, performance, marketing, comercial ou áreas correlatas).
  • Domínio de SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade de construir dashboards claros, objetivos e visualmente organizados.
  • Boa capacidade de interpretação de métricas e leitura crítica de resultados.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa interação com times multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com campanhas de incentivo, trade marketing, varejo ou força de vendas.
  • Conhecimento em Python para análises complementares e automações.
  • Vivência com apresentação de resultados para clientes ou áreas de negócio.
  • Noções de estatística aplicada e testes simples (comparativos, tendências, coortes etc.).
  • Habilidade de comunicação para transformar análise em narrativa (oral e escrita).

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios adicionais: plano de saúde, vale-refeição, vale-transporte e auxílio.
  • Home‑office.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

******TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO ELEGÍVEIS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA E REABILITADOS INSS.******

RESPONSÁIVAS DESTE CARGO

  • Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização de acordo com procedimento, orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança;
  • Acompanhar o andamento das atividades diárias verificando o RAD (relatório de atividade de diária), acompanhando a aplicação das técnicas de limpeza e higienização conforme procedimento;
  • Organizar a distribuição da equipe de trabalho, liderando equipes, definindo as tarefas a serem executadas e alocando nos setores;
  • Conferir e orientar os funcionários no correto preenchimento de Relatórios, durante as rondas no prédio e ao final do plantão;
  • Realizar checklist nos novos colaboradores conforme rotina estabelecida, esclarecendo sobre as normas disciplinares, instruções de trabalho, normas de segurança, visitação dos setores, visando adequada ambientação;
  • Conferir o abastecimento do material e distribuição quando necessário, checar o DML (depósito de material de limpeza) e carrinho funcional, para que o colaborador execute suas funções diárias;
  • Realizar o Checklist de limpeza em formulários específicos avaliando o resultado da limpeza/higienização, orientando a equipe quando detectada falha, assegurando o protocolo e padronização estabelecidos;
  • Monitorar a conduta disciplinar da equipe, orientando e corrigindo comportamentos inadequados, aplicando as punições cabíveis conforme código de conduta;
  • Atentar para a aplicação prática dos conhecimentos adquiridos nos treinamentos realizados no contrato, para multiplicação das práticas adequadas;
  • Garantir a correta utilização e distribuição do uniforme e EPIs, e orientar quanto ao adequado asseio pessoal dos auxiliares de limpeza, seguindo normas e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Preencher controle de EPI, registrando o equipamento disponibilizado ao colaborador, colhendo assinatura, conforme orientação a normas de segurança;
  • Verificar etiquetas dos produtos no estoque e diluídos, fazendo conferência de prazos de validade, conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos;
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto;
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas;
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato;
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato;
  • Fazer ronda nos setores orientando os auxiliares na execução das tarefas, na correta aplicação da técnica de limpeza, corrigindo postura, delegando atribuições e acompanhando a execução, a fim de avaliar o resultado conforme padrão estabelecido;
  • Encaminhar e acompanhar o funcionário, no caso de Acidente de Trabalho ou algum tipo de ocorrência médica, informando ao superior hierárquico, segurança do trabalho e os familiares sobre ocorrido;
  • Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados;
  • Comparecer em audiência como prepostos, representando a empresa, em processos judiciais e administrativos, caso haja requisição do departamento jurídico;
  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • ESCOLARIDADE MÍNIMO: Ensino Fundamental Completo ou 06 meses de experiência comprovada na função.
  • DESEJÁVEL: Ensino Médio Completo e ou 01 ano de experiência comprovada na função.
  • EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA MÍNIMO: 06 meses.
  • DESEJÁVEL: 01 ano.
  • HABILITAÇÃO / CERTIFICAÇÕES: Não aplicável.

Visão da MAG

#VemSerMAG Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito é oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

description:
What’s The Role

The Advanced Fuels Project Lead will be responsible for conducting end‑to‑end techno‑economic assessments across a portfolio of low‑carbon fuel pathways, from early conceptual definition and process modelling through to economic evaluation and decision‑support for business stakeholders. The role requires close collaboration with researchers, process engineers, technology developers, and commercial teams to ensure technical quality, coherence of assumptions, and transparent translation of results into Shell’s strategic options. The selected candidate will engage with internal Shell Experts to validate methodologies. The successful candidate will typically oversee and contribute to 6–10 technology projects.

  • Technology Theme Development and Assessment
  • Oversight and management of budget expenditure for projects delivered under his/her responsibility, guaranteeing the Levy compliance.
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to identify key technology themes of strategic importance to the Low‑Carbon Fuels (LCF) business and which can be developed through externally funded R&D projects.
  • Plan, facilitate and participate in technology workshops and other stakeholder events to develop an in‑depth understanding of the technology challenges and opportunities facing LCF and potential routes to solutions.
  • Lead Techno‑Economic Assessments (TEA) for emerging and advanced fuel pathways, including SAF, green/renewable diesel, hydrogen, e‑fuels, and biomass‑derived intermediates.
  • Develop and optimise detailed process models in Aspen Tech (or similar simulators), ensuring robust mass & energy balances and rigorous thermodynamic property selection.
  • Translate process simulation outputs into scalable cost models, including CAPEX, OPEX, sensitivity analyses, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Assess feedstock‑to‑fuel pathways, identifying technical bottlenecks, scale‑up barriers, integration opportunities, and overall commercial viability.
  • Benchmark novel technologies against conventional processes to support go/no‑go decisions, portfolio prioritisation, and strategic roadmaps.
  • Proposal Management
  • Align the projects under his/her responsibility with third parties with Shell Strategy.
  • Develop and make recommendations with respect to optimisation of its portfolio through value analysis, maximising R&D levy qualification and value delivered, building relationships with strategic partners, creating value for Shell and guaranteeing the real translation of the benefits to the company.
  • In conjunction with internal and external stakeholders review and rank project proposals in line with the Low‑Carbon Energy Programme strategic requirements, with particular focus on the assessment of business value to Shell and project risk management and mitigation.
  • Liaise with potential partners to ensure a common understanding of the technologies to be developed and provide technical support to the development of cooperation agreements to the strategic benefit of Shell.
  • Undertake the necessary due diligence and develop the necessary materials to take projects through the appropriate internal sanction process and provide the required technical and project management input to the finalisation of contracts with supplier(s).
  • Project Management
  • Provide project management expertise to ensure effective and timely delivery of Technology projects.
  • Set, agree and monitor performance standards for projects ensuring compliance especially HSSE and Ethics & Compliance standards/policies relevant to the R&D activities undertaken by suppliers and Universities.
  • Work closely with the developers and other funders to ensure that the sponsors' requirements are being met and if required, provide project management support to the developer team: meet with the developers on a regular basis to ensure that targets are being achieved and give project direction.
  • Ensure that projects are professionally managed and are driven to deliver the agreed outputs within budget, interfacing with Shell technical experts and assets as required.
  • Progress projects in the Technology maturation tollgates.
  • Relationship Management
  • Identify appropriate stakeholders and engage/manage relationships at appropriate level. This extends to other oil and gas companies, Universities, State and Federal Research Councils, Regulatory authorities e.g. ANP, CNPq etc.
  • Manage project relationships to ensure appropriate oversight of the projects, identify and maintain engagement in the programmes from the participants and promote integration between work streams towards a common goal.
  • General
  • Maintain surveillance of the wider technology arena, and track developments, competitor and supplier activity with potential relevance to the Low‑Carbon Tech agenda: attend relevant industry conferences, develop networks of contacts etc.
  • Communicate effectively at all levels, both internally and externally: share knowledge with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical or mechanical engineering is required (PhD degree is desirable).
  • 5+ years of experience in related field.
  • Technical and analytical expertise in research and development.
  • Strong expertise in Aspen Tech (steady‑state modelling, reactors, separation trains, property methods).
  • Proven experience conducting TEA for energy, fuels, or chemical processes, including cost estimation methodologies (estimates, equipment sizing, scaling laws).
  • Deep knowledge of process engineering principles, reaction systems, heat/mass transfer, and process integration.

O profissional será responsável por pesquisar, desenhar e orientar a implementação de soluções de ponta para proteger a organização contra ameaças cibernéticas avançadas, com foco especial em segurança para Inteligência Artificial, proteção de dados, resposta a incidentes e elevação da cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderança Técnica: Ser o ponto focal para discussões de arquitetura de segurança, orientando a equipe e as áreas de negócio na adoção de tecnologias e processos seguros.
  • Estratégia de Segurança de Dados: Desenvolver e liderar a implementação de um programa de proteção de dados, incluindo classificação da informação, Prevenção de Perda de Dados (DLP), criptografia e gerenciamento de direitos digitais.
  • Segurança em Inovação (IA/ML): Avaliar os riscos e definir os controles de segurança para projetos que utilizem Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, garantindo que a inovação ocorra de forma segura.
  • Resposta a Incidentes: Atuar como líder técnico na resposta a incidentes de segurança complexos, coordenando as ações de contenção, erradicação e recuperação, e conduzindo a análise de causa raiz.
  • Threat Intelligence e Threat Hunting: Liderar iniciativas de caça a ameaças (Threat Hunting) e consumir inteligência de ameaças (Threat Intelligence) para antecipar e mitigar ataques direcionados.
  • Cultura de Segurança (Awareness): Arquitetar e sustentar um programa de conscientização em segurança que seja relevante e eficaz, utilizando métricas para demonstrar a sua evolução.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Visão Holística de Segurança: Profundo conhecimento em múltiplas áreas, como Segurança de Redes, Segurança em Nuvem (AWS, Azure), Segurança de Endpoints (EDR/XDR), Gestão de Identidade e Acesso, e Segurança de Aplicações.
  • Frameworks de Mercado: Domínio de frameworks como NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001/27002 e MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Legislação e Conformidade: Conhecimento sólido em leis de proteção de dados (LGPD) e outros regulamentos do setor.
  • Liderança e Comunicação: Habilidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para diferentes públicos (técnico, executivo) e de influenciar decisões estratégicas.
  • Certificações (Diferencial): Certificações de prestígio como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ou especializações GIAC (GCFA, GCIH) são altamente desejáveis.

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

Design the future of decision-making in energy.

Landmark, Halliburton’s technology division, is modernizing a global enterprise platform used by geoscientists and engineers to make high-impact operational decisions. We are expanding our UX team and hiring for two dedicated roles:

  • UX Researcher
  • Senior UX Designer

These are distinct positions with focused scope, though hybrid profiles with strengths in both areas are welcome.

This is not incremental UI work. It is large-scale UX modernization across complex, legacy and cloud-based applications. You will help elevate product clarity, usability, and trust in deeply technical workflows used around the world.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customers to embed user-centered thinking into roadmap decisions and product execution.

What You’ll Do

If You Are a Senior UX Designer

You will lead the design of complex workflows and deliver end-to-end solutions that raise the craft quality of Landmark applications.

  • Own UX design for major workflows or product areas
  • Translate business and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable design solutions
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished visual designs
  • Apply and extend the Landmark design system; contribute new patterns when needed
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to align requirements and deliverables
  • Validate designs with users and iterate based on feedback
  • Participate in and elevate design reviews across the organization

If You Are a UX Researcher

You will embed insight into product strategy and modernization efforts, ensuring decisions are grounded in real user needs.

  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research across complex enterprise workflows
  • Lead usability testing, interviews, contextual inquiry, and journey mapping
  • Identify unmet user needs and opportunity areas within legacy and cloud applications
  • Synthesize findings into actionable insights for product and engineering teams
  • Influence roadmap decisions through evidence-based recommendations
  • Establish scalable research practices within product teams
  • Partner with designers to validate concepts and measure experience improvements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Senior UX Designer

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design
  • Mastery of interaction and visual design
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Familiarity with Angular or React-based systems preferred

UX Researcher

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, HCI, Psychology, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Experience conducting research in enterprise or technical domains
  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization

Job Overview

We are seeking a Lead Portfolio Manager to join the Portfolio Management Department (PMD).

The Portfolio Management Dept (PMD) serves as a centralized ownership and capital stewardship function for Saudi Aramco’s diversification investments and joint ventures.

Your primary role will be acts as the designated shareholder representative across assigned portfolio companies and is responsible for post-investment value realization, governance oversight, capital efficiency improvement, and performance accountability.

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Continuously assess portfolio company performance against original investment thesis.
  • Identify thesis erosion risks and recommend strategic realignment where necessary.
  • Provide structured shareholder-level perspective on long-term strategic positioning.
  • Develop and implement structured Value Creation Plans (VCPs) following investment close.
  • Establish measurable financial and operational targets (EBITDA growth, ROACE improvement, cash generation, working capital efficiency).
  • Monitor implementation rigor and quantify value capture.
  • Lead periodic value realization reviews.
  • Review reinvestment proposals and capital allocation decisions at portfolio company level.
  • Evaluate liquidity, leverage, covenant compliance, and refinancing risk.
  • Assess capital efficiency relative to Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) and shareholder return expectations.
  • Recommend capital structure optimization initiatives.
  • Assess governance effectiveness, including Board and sub-committee structure.
  • Support Aramco-nominated Directors with analytical pre-briefs and recommendations in advance of meetings.
  • Ensure reporting transparency and alignment with Aramco governance standards.
  • Promote disciplined decision-making at Board level.
  • Monitor variance against approved budgets and long-range plans.
  • Identify emerging operational or financial risks.
  • Recommend structured corrective actions and elevate material risks to the CIO where appropriate.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive positioning, and macroeconomic developments.
  • Translate market developments into shareholder-level implications.
  • Identify growth, consolidation, or restructuring opportunities within the portfolio.

Qualifications

As a successful candidate, you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited university. An Advanced degree is preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Private Equity, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Direct Industrial Investments, Consultants with experience of designing and implementing value creation plans and turnaround plans, and Investment Banking (restructuring / industrial sector coverage)
  • Experience in the Middle East or in emerging markets more broadly is a plus.
  • Be able to fully relocate to Saudi Arabia as an expat.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Job Description

This role is responsible for supporting the immigration requirements of client employees, ensuring compliance with applicable immigration laws and regulations while delivering a high level of client service. The Senior Associate plays a key role in managing immigration matters, whether aligned to a global account or a specific geographic region. This position requires close collaboration with corporate clients, employees, legal teams, government entities, and other stakeholders to facilitate efficient, compliant, and well‑coordinated immigration processes.   • Use a broad range of tools and techniques to identify and extract insights from trends within the business area.
  • Respond to client inquiries, concerns, and feedback in a timely, professional, and courteous manner.
  • Support the onboarding and training of new or junior team members on case management processes, immigration forms, and applications.
  • Stay current on relevant immigration laws, regulations, policies, and industry developments.
  • Depending on the service line, support the implementation and use of relevant technology platforms and tools.

  • Experience managing immigration casework in a corporate, consulting, or professional services environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Client‑service mindset with the ability to build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
