description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. The Assistant Director will provide comprehensive career counseling, develop strategic partnerships with the judiciary, and oversee programs and initiatives that enhance students' and graduates' competitiveness for clerkship positions. Additionally, this role will play an integral part in identifying and assisting with specialty fellowship development pipelines.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student workers, temporary personnel, administrative staff, and volunteers as needed. Reports to the Dean of Career & Professional Development, Lauren Jackson.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising:
  • Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in
  • judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development:
  • Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management:
  • Develop and manage programs that increase students' and graduates' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.
  • Administer funding opportunities, including stipends and fellowships, to support students pursuing unpaid clerkships.
  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.
  • Diversity and Inclusion:
  • Advocate for and support underrepresented students in pursuing clerkships and public interest careers, ensuring they have access to resources and opportunities.
  • Develop initiatives to increase diversity within judicial clerkships, including partnerships with affinity groups and diversity organizations.
  • Collaboration and Leadership:
  • Work closely with faculty, administration, and other career services staff to integrate clerkship advising across the curriculum.
  • Represent the law school at regional and national conferences focused on judicial clerkships and relevant public interest areas.
  • Stay informed of trends and developments in judicial clerkships to provide the most current and relevant advice to students and alumni.
  • Develop a clerkship advisory committee to assist with clerkship application review and advising.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in career services or academic advising in a law school setting.
  • Proven track record of placing students or graduates in judicial clerkships.
  • Active involvement in professional organizations related to judicial clerkships or public interest law.

Minimum Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Experience in judicial clerkships, either through serving as a clerk or in a related advisory role.
  • Familiarity with fellowship recruiting and application process.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders, including students, alumni, and judges.
  • Familiarity with the judicial clerkship application process, including OSCAR.

Compensation Range - $75,000 - $85,000

At Riveron, a nationally recognized business advisory firm, we combine deep industry knowledge with innovative technology to drive meaningful business outcomes. We’re seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with a strong focus on Salesforce Sales Cloud to join our Technology & Innovation team. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize scalable Salesforce solutions that support sales operations, revenue growth, and go-to-market strategies across the enterprise. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders to translate sales processes into high-performing, secure, and maintainable Salesforce applications.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of hands‑on Salesforce development experience, with deep expertise in Sales Cloud.
  • You are highly proficient in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL.
  • You have designed and implemented Sales Cloud data models, including Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Products, Price Books, Quotes, and Forecasting.

  • You have a strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field‑level security.
  • You are skilled in Salesforce declarative automation tools, including Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and (where applicable) Process Builder.
  • You actively contribute in Agile development environments, participating in sprint planning, estimations, code reviews, and technical discussions.
  • You are familiar with CI/CD practices and tools such as Git, Copado, Gearset, and Salesforce DX.
  • You hold a Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (required).
  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and business teams, acting as a trusted advisor for sales‑related solutions.
  • You write clean, scalable, and well‑documented code aligned with Salesforce best practices and long‑term maintainability.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Sales Cloud solutions that support lead‑to‑cash and opportunity management processes.
  • Design and enhance custom objects, Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) to meet sales and revenue requirements.
  • Build and optimize functionality related to Leads, Opportunities, Products, Pricing, Quotes, Sales Forecasting, and Pipelines.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable integrations between Salesforce Sales Cloud and external systems (CRM, ERP, finance, and marketing platforms).
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate sales strategies into effective technical solutions.
  • Automate and streamline sales workflows using Flows and Apex, ensuring performance and governor limit compliance.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with Salesforce best practices.
  • Support DevOps and deployment activities, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and release management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to sales users.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, solution design artifacts, and knowledge sharing within the development team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer II, Salesforce Administrator, or App Builder.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ or advanced pricing and quoting solutions.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and dashboards to support sales performance insights.
  • Experience working with multi‑region or global sales organizations.
  • Exposure to Salesforce integration patterns and enterprise‑scale implementations.
  • Prior experience mentoring junior developers or leading technical initiatives.
  • Background in professional services, consulting, or enterprise transformation projects.

About Riveron

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high‑growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. title: Ubuntu Security Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is building a team dedicated to providing security coverage across a wide range of ecosystems and environments, working to make the world a better, safer place. We are hiring an Ubuntu Security Engineer to join an industry‑leading security engineering team and help protect the open source community and Ubuntu users from emerging threats. We are looking for candidates across all levels of experience, from Graduate to Senior.

As part of the Ubuntu Security Team, you will work with some of the best and brightest people in technology to monitor, triage, respond to, and document new and existing vulnerabilities in open source software. You will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to identify issues, prioritize them, and coordinate remediation.

This is an engineering‑focused role that may also involve activities such as producing security assessments, building features, conducting code reviews, developing internal tools, engaging with the open source community, and participating in industry initiatives and events.

This role requires international travel at least twice a year, usually for one week. It also requires the ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self‑discipline and self‑motivation.

Location: Worldwide, this is a globally remote role.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzing, fixing, and testing vulnerabilities in open source packages
  • Keeping track of vulnerabilities in the Ubuntu ecosystem as they are discovered, researched, and fixed, leveraging internal tools
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu community and upstream developers, as needed, to exchange or develop vulnerability patches and ensure that Ubuntu includes the most robust security features
  • Auditing source code for vulnerabilities
  • Building features and tools to help teams strengthen the security of their products and contribute to the overall security of Ubuntu

Qualifications

  • You have a thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities and techniques for fixing them
  • You are familiar with coordinated disclosure practices
  • You are familiar with open source development tools and methodologies
  • You are skilled in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • You have excellent logic, problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and decision‑making skills
  • You can clearly and effectively communicate with the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi‑cultural, multi‑national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Mecânico Diesel
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio das suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Sua missão

  • Elabora desempeno de chassis, planos de manutenção; realiza manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores.
  • Substitui peças, repara e testa desempenho de componentes e sistemas de veículos.
  • Efetua diagnóstico e reparo em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos, socorre veículos, atuando como motorista até o local do socorro.
  • Realiza serviços de lubrificação dos veículos utilizando bomba de lubrificação em eixos, quinta roda, sistema direcional, embuchamento e suspenção de acordo com a demanda especifica de cada veículo (preventiva e corretiva).
  • Faz orçamento de mão de obra e peças a serem aplicadas.
  • Realização habitual e intermitente de solda elétrica por eletrodos.
  • Quando necessário, sendo habilitado e autorizado, dirige veículos de propriedade da empresa para atendimento externos aos clientes.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Informática Básica.
  • Noção/experiência em mecânica de autos ou pesados.
  • Desejável curso técnico em mecânica.
  • Imprescindivel disponibilidade de viagens!

Vantagens / Benefícios

  • Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
  • Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.

description:
REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência. O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência. Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de Interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • 1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:
  • 1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.
  • 1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato, caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.
  • 1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO, ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). *O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso*.
  • 1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.
  • 1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.
  • 1.7.6 o Processo Seletivo Será Composto De
    • 1ª ETAPA - Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
    • 2ª ETAPA - Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
    • 3ª ETAPA - Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
    • 4ª ETAPA - Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.

Somente possuirá direito a contratação o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado.

Descrição Do Cargo

  • Elaborar e organizar documentos comprobatórios de despesas e receitas para prestação de contas;
  • Conferir notas fiscais, garantindo sua conformidade com contratos e processos de compras;
  • Verificar guias de recolhimento de impostos, incluindo tributos sobre folha de pagamento e prestação de serviços;
  • Analisar e conferir folhas de pagamento;
  • Controlar e verificar a vigência de certidões fiscais;
  • Apoiar na consolidação de informações e relatórios utilizando Excel;
  • Manter a organização e atualização de arquivos físicos e digitais.

Diferenciais

title: Director, HSE - LATAM&C
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

Objective

Provide strategic leadership and oversight of Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) performance across LATAM&C, ensuring full alignment with Worley’s global and regional HSE strategy. The role is responsible for driving a strong HSE culture, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing risk across EPC/EPCM projects and locations, and advising senior leadership on HSE matters. The Director, HSE enables safe project delivery, supports business development activities, and ensures organizational readiness, capability, and resources to achieve Worley’s HSE objectives across the region.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deploy the HSE strategy across LATAM&C in alignment with Worley’s global and regional guidelines, Values, and Behaviors.
  • Ensure effective implementation of HSE programs across projects and locations in LATAM&C.
  • Ensure HSE function in LATAM&C is adequately resourced to meet Worley’s HSE expectations and objectives.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on health, safety, and environmental decision‑making, ensuring compliance with legislation and regional and global guidelines.
  • Identify, assess, and control risks associated with the business (location and projects) including identification and compliance with legal and other applicable requirements.
  • Support Business Development and capture team during the project opportunity development (Middle Game and End Game) by reviewing HSE risks and responsibilities.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to the Regional HSE Lead (primary reporting line), with dotted‑line reporting to the GO/MPP Senior Vice Presidents, regarding location HSE programs and processes.
  • Drive HSE capability development through training and competency‑building initiatives across locations and projects in LATAM&C.
  • Establish HSE Committees in the locations to promote and communicate performance across the location and projects.
  • Work with regional and project HSE teams to design and implement programs and campaigns aimed at eliminating or minimizing undesired events.
  • Ensure HSE readiness and governance prior to project mobilization and during execution.
  • Implement and monitor the contractor management program.
  • Ensure emergency preparedness, response readiness, and crisis management capability across locations and projects.
  • Conduct regular field visits and leadership engagements at client, project, and operational sites.

Technical Requirements / Education / Experience

  • Academic background in Health and Safety, or Engineering (Chemical, Industrial, or related disciplines).
  • Master’s degree or specialization in Occupational Health, Environmental practices, or related.
  • 20+ years of relevant experience, including significant leadership, supervisory, and management responsibility.
  • Proven experience in large‑scale EPC/EPCM projects is highly required.
  • Experience within the Energy and Resources sector (Oil & Gas, Minerals and Metals) is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead diverse and remote teams to align Worley’s HSE strategy across the region.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable health, safety, and environmental legislation and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience applying incident investigation methodologies (TapRooT, ICAM, 5 Whys).
  • Solid knowledge of emergency response planning and risk mitigation.
  • Desirable experience with process risk methodologies such as HAZID, HAZOP, Bowtie, LOPA, among others.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI).
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus.

Required Competencies

Decision Making

Makes independent decisions and recommendations in the course of managing multiple functional disciplines, a larger functional discipline, or a significant‑size project. Decisions involve long‑range planning, coordination, and technical matters that may be specific or far‑reaching. Develops and oversees the implementation of strategic programs and policies for their groups, which may impact the region, location, or large projects. Demonstrates the ability to manage multiple complex projects through others. Works frequently with location and regional management on matters that significantly influence business results.

Supervision

Operates with broad management authority, receiving minimal technical guidance and control. Limited only by general objectives and organizational policies. Work is reviewed to ensure alignment with company vision, mission, and direction. Typically has both direct and indirect reports. Makes decisions related to the selection, training, discipline, and remuneration of staff. Establishes policy frameworks and long‑term mission and vision.

Communication

Effectively communicates and presents complex proposals and reports to senior management. Demonstrates the ability to persuade and influence others. Employs a participative management style with a collaborative, team‑oriented approach.

Systems, Processes & Tools

Demonstrates expert understanding of systems, processes, and tools related to the field. Able to coach and support others. May be involved in the development of new systems, processes, and tools.

Place of Work

Any LATAM&C location

Accessibility Adjustments

If you need any accessibility adjustments , please make sure to mention it in your application.

Moving forward together

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. And we’re not just talking about it; we’re doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low‑carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos. Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento. E não para por aí! A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia. Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos. O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara! A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como “A marca mais amada do Rio” e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a “Marca preferida dos Cariocas”. E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

title: Líder de Turno (Rio de Janeiro/RJ)
description:
Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

  • Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade, atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
  • Estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país, com 50 anos de existência.
  • Visamos o cuidado e respeito ao meio ambiente, com isso tivemos mais de 660 milhões de m³ de efluentes tratados por nossos clientes até hoje (o equivalente ao consumo de água da população do estado de SP, 12 milhões de pessoas, durante um ano).
  • Nosso maior objetivo é a expansão da nossa organização, em 2033 nossa meta é expandir nossa atuação no Brasil e com isso contamos um time de 500 colaboradores divididos nas 5 frentes de atuação da EP.

Temos quatro valores que regem nossos direcionamentos e atuação na EP, que são:

  • Paixão por aprender: Aqui valorizamos, incentivamos e investimos pesado em educação. Somos uma empresa que presta serviço, ou seja, vendemos o conhecimento do nosso time e por isso oferecemos diversas maneiras para que você tenha acesso aos melhores cursos e se desenvolvam profissionalmente.
  • Falo e faço: É o valor que garante um ambiente íntegro e coerente entre o discurso e as ações. Transparência e honestidade são essenciais em qualquer relação dentro e fora da EP, com colaboradores, clientes, fornecedores e comunidade.
  • Visto a camisa: Para termos sucesso no mercado e qualidade em cada serviço que fornecemos, valorizamos que nossos colaboradores estejam alinhados com nosso propósito e que possam exercer suas funções em sua totalidade e com segurança.
  • Hoje melhor que ontem: Acreditamos que se todos buscarem fazer hoje algo melhor do que fizeram ontem, visando melhoria continua, seremos uma empresa melhor a cada dia também. Para nós qualidade é nosso combustível que nos mantém ativos.

Se você, assim como nós, também é movido à água e quer fazer a diferença no mundo. Vem com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão do cargo

As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.

Como será seu dia a dia

  • Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
  • Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
  • Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
  • Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
  • Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
  • Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;
  • Operar e realizar pequenas manutenções em equipamentos pertinentes à área;
  • Controlar e organizar o estoque de reagentes, vidrarias e equipamentos do laboratório, reportando necessidades de reposição;
  • Realizar coleta de amostras para análise em laboratório;
  • Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
  • Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Requisitos e qualificações

Pré-requisitos para essa função

  • Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
  • Curso superior será um diferencial;
  • CRQ ativo;
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com tratamento de água/ efluentes.

O que esperamos de você

  • Participe dos treinamentos e diálogos de segurança oferecidos;
  • Conserve seu local de trabalho e EPIs com limpeza e organização;
  • Colabore com o time no atingimento de objetivos do setor;
  • Realize com seu superior direto Feedbacks trimestrais;
  • Busque aplicar nossos valores no dia a dia dentro e fora da EP;
  • Comprometimento e ética junto ao time e cliente.

Salário: A combinar

Jornada: 2x2 ou horário administrativo, dependendo da demanda

Modalidade: Presencial

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a Gas Commercial Specialist to join our Innovation & Technology Management Group (ITMG) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)

ITMG is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations.

Your Primary role is to analyze and support strategic decision-making processes that optimize profitability, efficiency, and competitiveness in gas-related operations. You will also play a multidisciplinary in economic analysis, financial planning, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency to support Saudi Aramco’s gas business.

Key Responsibilities:

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Contribute to optimizing Gross Product Worth (GPW) and Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT).
  • Evaluate the Return on Average Capital Employed (ROACE), and ensure the economic life of assets (such as pipelines and processing facilities) is maximized. This involves assessing capital expenditures, operational costs, and revenue forecasts using methodologies like Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
  • Collaborate with energy and operation teams to implement energy efficiency initiatives, by analyzing data, modeling scenarios, and identifying energy-saving opportunities.
  • Reduce operational costs and enhance the overall efficiency of gas production and processing.
  • Analyze regional and global natural gas markets, including LNG, pipeline gas, NGLs, condensate, and associated products.
  • Develop gas demand–supply forecasts (short, medium, and long term).
  • Monitor macroeconomic indicators and assess their impact on gas business performance.
  • Evaluate price trends, energy competition (renewables, hydrogen), and policy changes.
  • Develop gas pricing models for various segments (power, industrial, petrochemicals).
  • Prepare economic justification for CAPEX and OPEX approvals.
  • Analyze gas supply contracts, demand profiles, and flexibility options to optimize the company’s gas portfolio.
  • Support balancing between long-term, mid-term, and spot gas strategies.
  • Recommend decisions on gas allocation, curtailment plans, and supply–demand balancing strategies.
  • Prepare comprehensive economic reports, dashboards, and presentations for senior leadership.
  • Deliver insights on risks, market dynamics, and strategic opportunities.
  • Support annual planning, corporate strategy development, and regulatory submissions.
  • Work closely with planning, operations, commercial, finance, and strategy teams.
  • Participate in investment review committees, commercial negotiations, and strategic projects.
  • Provide insights for policy development and regulatory frameworks.
  • As the successful candidate you hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Industrial Engineering, Process Engineer, Mechanical, System Engineer). An advanced degree in Energy Economics, MBA, or Applied Economics is preferred.
  • You will have minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in Gas market analysis, Energy Economics, Commercial Planning, Oil & gas business planning, and Industrial commercial operations.
  • You will have Energy Risk Professional (ERP) certification.
  • Professional certifications such as CERA certificate or CFA Level ½ are preferred
  • You will have a strong background in Gas pricing mechanisms, Economic modeling (NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity), Energy demand modeling, Scenario and risk analysis, Supply–demand balancing and optimization and understanding of gas processing and network.
  • You will be able to demonstrate Advanced economic modeling skills
  • You will have experience with energy economic tools (Palisade @Risk, PLEXOS, or similar).
  • You will have knowledge of global gas hubs (TTF, NBP, HH) and regional gas dynamics.
  • You will be able to simplify complex economic insights for executives.
  • You will have strategic thinking and commercial awareness and strong quantitative and analytical skills

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Service Engineer, Offshore Cranes
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.

More Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
  • Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
  • Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
  • Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports as required
  • Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
  • Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor

Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor’s office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
  • Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

Values guide our work

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

Additional Information

description:
Descrição Sumária

INSCRIÇÕES ABERTAS – até 30/03/2026. O prazo poderá ser alterado sem aviso prévio.

  • O profissional atuará na área operacional de um projeto ou de uma proposta, incorporado no PMT, e será responsável por coordenar as atividades de planejamento de projetos de alta complexidade, estabelecendo interfaces estratégicas com o cliente, fornecedores e demais membros do time de projeto.
  • É esperado que este (a) profissional execute as atividades com robusto domínio das ferramentas de planejamento e do escopo de projetos EPCI.
  • Dentro do projeto se reportará ao “Gerente de Controle de Projeto”, dependendo do tipo de projeto; e funcionalmente ao “Gerente de Planejamento” e ficará locado no Escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades e Desafios Principais

Desenvolver e conduzir, desde o estágio inicial, o cronograma de projetos EPCI complexos na fase de BID, estruturando WBS, considerando restrições contratuais, folgas estratégicas, simulações e cenários alternativos, com autonomia, confidencialidade e alinhamento às regras corporativas. Implementar a WBS do projeto e analisar documentação de propostas e contratos, emitindo os documentos de planejamento conforme requisitos.

Realizar análise crítica aplicando a metodologia CPM, propondo soluções quando necessário. Garantir que mudanças do BID ou do contrato sejam refletidas e avaliadas no cronograma, permitindo identificar possíveis Variation Orders do cliente. Desenvolver análises de cenário considerando diferentes layouts submarinos e sequenciamentos operacionais, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisão.

Gerenciar no cronograma o planejamento de fornecedores e subcontratados, definindo metodologia de medição de progresso de acordo com exigências contratuais. Manter comunicação eficaz com fornecedores, subcontratados e equipes internas, consolidando o cronograma do BID ou do projeto. Acompanhar pacotes de fabricação dos equipamentos para garantir consistência entre os cronogramas.

Construir, junto ao cliente, o cronograma Baseline do projeto e realizar eventuais re-baselines ao longo do avanço. Garantir integração entre Project Controllers, Package Managers e Contract Managers, assegurando qualidade das entregas. Identificar riscos e oportunidades relacionadas ao planejamento.

Coletar e inserir dados de progresso no cronograma, avaliando impactos conforme métodos definidos em contrato. Gerenciar mudanças de escopo, correções e impactos no planejamento, em colaboração com o Project Controls Manager. Orientar e apoiar Analistas de Planejamento em diferentes níveis, atuando como referência técnica. Assegurar a aplicação dos padrões de planejamento da Subsea 7 e disseminar conhecimento da disciplina na organização.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Domínio de Primavera P6 e MS Project.
  • Power BI avançado.
  • Noções sólidas de gestão e planejamento de projetos.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento em Primavera Risk Analysis e Crystal Ball.
  • Noções do módulo de planejamento do ProArc.

Formação

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia (ciências exatas). Desejável.

Experiência

Desejável experiência mínima de 8 anos em Planejamento de Projetos. Capacidade de elaborar planos de ação sempre que necessário.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

Join Howard University and thrive with us!
 are seeking a key role for the School of Social Work. Reporting to the Associate Dean and operating under the Office of Academic and Student Advancement, the Clinical Education Director provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for all supervised field education and practicum experiences within the MSW program, serving both on-campus and online students. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, accessibility, compliance, and continuous improvement of agency-based education in alignment with the Council on Social Work Education (CSWE) Educational Policy and Accreditation Standards (EPAS).
This role serves as a strategic leader responsible for guiding the continued evolution, growth, and innovation of the Agency-Based Education enterprise. The Director leads efforts to enhance systems, workflows, staffing models, agency partnerships, and student support structures in alignment with best practices, emerging trends, and technologies in social work field education, and the School’s commitment to equitable access, accreditation integrity, operational excellence, and student success across residential and online learning environments.
The position requires the implementation of structured accessibility and communication systems to support students enrolled across multiple U.S. time zones and evening instructional schedules, reflecting the school’s commitment to inclusion, equity, and student success.
Supervisory Authority
This position provides direct or indirect supervision of faculty consultants/liaisons, administrative staff, and assigned graduate or undergraduate student workers
Nature and Scope
Internal contacts include the Dean’s Office, senior administrators, program directors, faculty, students, and staff; HUSSW committees; and university-wide units such as the Office of Student Accessibility, University Counseling Services, and the Office of General Counsel.
External contacts include agency supervisors and administrators, third-party online program partners, community organizations, CSWE and other accreditation entities, licensure bodies, and vendors.
This is an onsite position. Operational availability is required to support students and faculty across PST, MST, CST, and EST time zones, as well as evening academic schedules during peak periods such as orientation, registration, and graduation.
Principal Accountabilities
I. Strategic Leadership & Program Governance
  • Provide vision, leadership, and strategic direction for Agency-Based Education across all MSW modalities
  • Serve as the institutional expert for agency-based education governance, policy development, and operational decision-making
  • Represent Agency-Based Education on School and University committees to ensure alignment with academic and student success priorities
II. Systems Design & Modernization
  • Lead the continued evolution and modernization of the Agency-Based Education function by enhancing systems, workflows, and operational models to build capacity for current and future program needs
  • Implement scalable, technology-enabled systems for student intake, placement tracking, agency management, and compliance monitoring
  • Advance and formalize standardize processes that support scalability, equity, transparency, and a consistent student experience across modalities as agency-based education continues to grow
  • Lead change management initiatives to support faculty, staff, students, and agency partners through operational transitions
III. Student Accessibility & Learner Support
  • Design and manage a student-centered accessibility framework enabling students to proactively communicate availability, work schedules, learning needs, and accommodation considerations
  • Establish service standards and response expectations to ensure equitable access for all MSW students
  • Oversee student placement support, remediation strategies, and escalation processes when placement challenges arise
IV. Agency Partnership Development & Oversight
  • Recruit, evaluate, approve, and maintain agency partnerships
  • Establish agency quality standards and site evaluation protocols
  • Serve as final authority for agency continuation or termination
V. Accreditation, Assessment & Compliance
  • Ensure alignment with CSWE EPAS standards
  • Lead accreditation documentation, reporting, and assessment
  • Maintain governing manuals, policies, and procedures
VI. Administration & Supervision
  • Supervise staff, ABE faculty, and student employees
  • Plan, oversee, and ensure the delivery of comprehensive orientation and ongoing training of students, ABE faculty, and staff
  • Set expectations, conduct evaluations, and manage performance
  • Oversee operations during peak academic cycles
Core Competencies
  • Program Governance & Operational Design Demonstrated capability to design, implement, and oversee governance structures, workflows, and operational models that support scalable, high-quality agency-based education.
  • Accreditation & Compliance Stewardship Ability to anticipate, manage, and uphold accreditation, compliance, and standards associated with field education and clinical training requirements.
  • Strategic Leadership & Change Management Ability to lead complex organizational change, rebuild systems, and guide stakeholders through transformation and modernization efforts.
  • Student-Centered Systems Thinking Ability to design equitable, accessible systems that support diverse student populations across modalities, time zones, and professional obligations.
  • Agency Partnership & External Relations Leadership Proven ability to build, evaluate, and sustain strategic partnerships with external agencies and community stakeholders.
  • Data-Informed Decision Making Ability to use data, assessment outcomes, and continuous improvement frameworks to inform strategy, accreditation reporting, and program enhancement.
  • People Leadership & Talent Development Ability to lead, coach, and manage professional staff, faculty collaborators, and student employees with accountability and empathy
Minimal Requirements
  • MSW from an accredited institution
  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience
  • Demonstrated experience with program evolution or systems redesign
  • Advanced knowledge of CSWE accreditation standards
  • Experience managing agency partnerships and student placement outcomes
  • Strong leadership, change management, and stakeholder engagement skills
Preferred Requirements
  • Doctoral degree (PhD, DSW, EdD)
  • Social work licensure
  • Experience with online or hybrid academic programs
  • Familiarity with academic technologies (Workday, Course Dog, placement platforms)

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desempenhar atividades de enfermagem, sob a supervisão do enfermeiro, realizar coleta de material biológico e outras atividades administrativas garantindo o fluxo adequado dos exames ocupacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter idade minima de 18 anos completos.
  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Curso de Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho Completo.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência de 06 meses comprovada na função de Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho.

title: Assistente de Departamento Pessoal
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

O profissional atua diretamente no atendimento aos colaboradores, oferecendo suporte geral, esclarecimento de dúvidas e participação nas integrações de novos funcionários. É responsável pelo controle e fechamento do ponto eletrônico, bem como pelo sistema de vale alimentação (Gente), além da emissão e envio de contracheques.

Presta apoio completo no processo de admissão, realizando o cadastro de novos colaboradores, conferência de documentação, envio de contratos, integração e abertura de benefícios. Também participa dos processos de desligamento, incluindo homologações e orientações relacionadas às verbas rescisórias.

Faz a administração diária dos benefícios, como Vale Transporte (VT) e Vale Alimentação (VA), bem como os lançamentos, conferências e apoio nos fechamentos da folha de pagamento.

Mantém a organização e atualização dos documentos e arquivos do setor, prestando suporte em auditorias internas e externas, quando necessário. Além disso, realiza a interface com a contabilidade e fornecedores, incluindo o uso de sistemas como o ASOS.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

  • Formação: Ensino Superior
  • Experiência anterior na área de Departamento Pessoal.
  • Conhecimento nas rotinas de admissão, demissão, controle de ponto eletrônico e administração de benefícios.
  • Familiaridade com o sistema Vale Alimentação Gente e/ou outros sistemas similares de ponto.
  • Conhecimento básico de folha de pagamento e encargos trabalhistas.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

  • Salário: R$ 2.338,69
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 25,00 p/dia
  • Vale Transporte

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Contrato: CLT

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ESPECIALISTA EM SISTEMAS DE TI - SAP FI/CO
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de umEspecialista em Sistemas de TI - SAP FI/CO que terá a missão de garantir a liderança técnica e funcional da área de SAP FI/CO em um programa estratégico de transformação digital, conduzindo o desenho, a implementação e a sustentação do SAP S/4HANA em abordagem Greenfield, com foco em Fit-to-Standard e SAP Best Practices. Atuará como guardião do template financeiro, assegurando governança de decisões, mínima customização e alta qualidade das entregas, promovendo integração ponta-a-ponta com demais módulos e áreas de negócio. Colaborar de forma ativa com consultoria integradora e áreas internas de Finanças, Controladoria e TI, garantindo que os requisitos corporativos sejam traduzidos em soluções padronizadas, robustas e sustentáveis, suportando a evolução do negócio e a excelência operacional no setor de energia.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a frente FI/CO (FI + CO) no programa, atuando como principal referência para desenho, decisões e entregas do stream.
  • Definir e manter o plano de trabalho do stream (entregáveis, marcos, dependências, riscos, backlog e priorização).
  • Garantir a qualidade do desenho funcional e do customizing em S/4HANA Finance (incluindo validação de decisões com o negócio).
  • Assegurar que o stream FI/CO esteja aderente ao Fit-to-Standard, evitando customizações desnecessárias e orientando o time para soluções padrão.
  • Coordenar com a consultoria e times técnicos os artefatos do projeto: blueprint/delta design, especificações funcionais, critérios de aceite, documentação e handover.
  • Liderar o planejamento e execução de testes (SIT, UAT), incluindo definição de cenários end-to-end, dados de teste, rastreabilidade e resolução de defeitos.
  • Conduzir a preparação para cutover e go-live do ponto de vista FI/CO (tarefas, pré-requisitos, reconciliações, validações e plano de contingência).
  • Garantir governança de processos de fechamento contábil e controles internos no novo ambiente (compliance, auditoria, trilhas e reconciliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em análises de sistemas ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência sólida em SAP S/4HANA Finance, com domínio de: Universal Journal (ACDOCA) e impactos em contabilidade e controladoria. New GL, estruturas organizacionais, ledger(s), moedas, princípios contábeis, settings de closing. AP/AR, pagamentos, cobranças, integrações bancárias e conciliações. New Asset Accounting (FI-AA) e processos de CAPEX/AUC. CO: centros de custo, ordens internas, profit center, rateio/alocação, planejamento (quando aplicável), CO-PA (account-based / costing-based conforme estratégia).
  • Conhecimento de Fiori apps relevantes para Finance e experiência na validação de usabilidade/controles.
  • Capacidade de avaliar impactos em relatórios e analytics (ex.: CDS views, embedded analytics), em parceria com BI/Reporting.
  • Forte entendimento de controles, auditoria e compliance, especialmente em processos de fechamento e reconciliação.
  • Habilidades de liderança, gestão e relacionamento com stakeholders.Coordenação de consultores (internos e integradora), alinhamento de prioridades e garantia de entregas.
  • Gestão de riscos e dependências (RAIDs), comunicação executiva e escalonamento quando necessário).
  • Certificações desejáveis (não mandatórias): SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Financial Accounting. SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA for Management Accounting. Certificações relacionadas ao SAP Activate (ou experiência comprovada na metodologia).
  • Diferenciais: certificações em áreas correlatas (Treasury, Analytics, Project Management).

Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Cesta de natal.
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de treinamentos.

Local de Trabalho: Av. Marechal Floriano/RJ

title: Data Architect  - Analista Pleno
description:
Responsável por construir, otimizar e manter modelos conceituais e lógicos de banco de dados.

Principais atividades

  • Apoiar em desenhos de soluções em escalas e plataformas capazes de gerenciar grandes quantidades de dados, estruturados e não estruturados, mesmo em modo de real time, através da escolha correta de arquiteturas de referência.
  • Colaborar com uma arquitetura de dados horizontal que fomente o reuso de soluções por diversas áreas da companhia otimizando os custos de implantação e de operação;
  • Desenhar soluções que garantam toda a governança, privacidade e qualidade dos dados;
  • Apoiar nas aplicações de políticas da empresa em termos de privacidade e segurança no acesso aos dados;
  • Descrever as tecnologias específicas em termos de integração entre componentes e fluxos lógicos de interação;
  • Observar as tendências tecnológicas emergentes e dar indicações sobre as melhores práticas;
  • Colaborar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria por meio de integrações e substituições de sistemas legados;
  • Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação;
  • Contribuir com a disseminação de uma cultura de Data-Driven Decision na companhia, fazendo interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Conhecimento sobre pipeline de dados e todas as suas fases, desde a ingestão até tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento técnico de estruturas de dados (Bancos Relacionais, Não Relacionais e Big Data);
  • Conhecimento de soluções de nuvem, especialmente em Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência na arquitetura de dados, especialmente em ambientes GCP e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, Python, Java, etc.);
  • Ferramentas de visualização e exploração de dados (Power BI, Tableau, SAS, Data Studio etc);
  • Metodologias desenvolvimento lean/agile;
  • Experiência na coleta e análise de requisitos do sistema;
  • Cursando ensino superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Senior) ID52039
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer , you’ll build and optimize a multi-tenant SaaS platform, shaping both frontend and backend systems to deliver seamless, data-driven experiences. You’ll work with modern cloud technologies, influence product decisions, and directly impact performance, scalability, and business outcomes in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build a multi-tenant, role-based SaaS UI using React;
  • Develop data-heavy views powered by BigQuery;
  • Implement high-performance filtering, pagination, and caching;
  • Enable secure file downloads using short-lived GCS signed URLs;
  • Design and implement backend services and integrations using Python (FastAPI);
  • Deploy FastAPI services on Cloud Run;
  • Build product endpoints using Cloud Functions;
  • Implement authentication and authorization using Firebase;
  • Develop production-grade APIs with logging, monitoring, and reliability;
  • Write performant BigQuery SQL;
  • Design tenant-safe data access patterns;
  • Collaborate on dbt models and transformation logic;
  • Optimize queries for cost and latency;
  • Work with GCP services including BigQuery, Firestore, GCS, Cloud Run, IAM, and Secret Manager;
  • Implement infrastructure as code with Terraform;
  • Ensure observability, monitoring, and cost awareness;
  • Contribute to building a data stack to handle AI agentic workflows.

MUST HAVES

  • 2+ years building production full stack systems;
  • Strong in Python and SQL;
  • Familiar with GCP or AWS;
  • Strong in React with experience building real SaaS dashboards;
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience;
  • Comfortable shipping features end-to-end without handholding;
  • Experienced in fast-moving startup environments;
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

SOBRE NÓS!
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí!
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?

title: Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non‑competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all‑staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament‑time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament‑time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end‑to‑end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiner’s first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

Your Profile

  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The Digital Marketing Strategist supports the development and execution of integrated digital marketing strategies for a diverse client portfolio. This role blends strategic thinking with hands‑on execution. Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Support marketing audits and campaign reviews to identify growth opportunities.

Client & Team Collaboration

  • Prepare marketing strategies, campaign briefs, and performance reports with the Associate Director of Brand Strategy.
  • Translate marketing insights and data into actionable recommendations.
  • Work with designers, developers, content creators, and marketing leadership to ensure alignment between strategy, creative execution, and campaign performance.

What We're Looking For

Core Skills

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals across multiple channels

Mindset & Qualities

  • Curious and eager to learn new marketing disciplines

  • Collaborative and comfortable working in cross‑functional teams
  • Adaptable in a fast‑moving agency environment
  • Can work independently and proactively problem solve

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1‑3 years of experience in digital marketing, marketing strategy, influencer marketing or other agency environments
  • Experience supporting or managing campaigns across multiple digital channels
  • Familiarity with marketing and analytics tools such as:
  • Google Analytics / GA4

Why Join 500 Designs

  • Work with an award‑winning creative and digital strategy team

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
