Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Research Assistant will provide support for women’s health and urogynecology research studies. This position will assist with participant recruitment and engagement including outreach and study advertising activities. This position will consent and enroll participants and coordinate study visits. This position will provide administrative support for Division of Urogynecology operations. This position will also contribute to data analysis and dissemination of data.

Supervisory Authority

This position reports to the Chief of Urogynecology and coordinates with other members of the research team. This position has no formal supervisory authority or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

This position supports research within the Division of Urogynecology, OBGYN Department and Howard University/Howard University Hospital. This position may interact with a variety of participants, clinicians, staff and faculty. They may also interact with research partners, advisory board participants, and other stakeholders.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Prepare and contribute to meeting notes, summaries, and presentations
  • Recruit, screen, and consent study participants in accordance with approved protocols
  • Schedule and coordinate study sessions, assessments, and follow‑up visits across sites
  • Maintain participant tracking databases and ensure data quality and confidentiality
  • Support the preparation and submission of IRB documents, progress reports, and other regulatory materials
  • Contribute to preparing manuscripts, presentations, and study materials
  • Communicate regularly with site clinicians and research partners to monitor study progress and troubleshoot challenges
  • Participate in research meetings and provide updates on recruitment and data collection
  • Perform general administrative and research support tasks, including providing and tracking participant stipends, ordering study supplies and materials, and filing
  • Use designated software to support study operations, data management, tracking, and reporting
  • Provide administrative support in Division of Urogynecology
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Core Competencies

  • Ability to read and write English is required
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative research
  • Skills in Office Microsoft, Zoom, and other applicable apps
  • Strong Administrative skills
  • Knowledge of the research techniques related to the purpose of the research studies
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team across multiple studies
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with diverse participants and professionals
  • Working knowledge of research ethics and confidentiality
  • Familiarity with REDCap, Qualtrics, or similar data collection platforms preferred

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar queries altamente complexas em SQL Server, garantindo máxima performance e escalabilidade;

  • Atuar como referência técnica para outros desenvolvedores, apoiando revisões de código e decisões de arquitetura de dados;

  • Experiência avançada e comprovada com SQL Server em ambientes de missão crítica;
  • Domínio de T-SQL e técnicas de otimização de código para alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados relacional, normalização e práticas de governança de dados;
  • Experiência consistente na criação e otimização de stored procedures, functions, triggers e views complexas;
  • Expertise em tuning de performance, índices, particionamento e análise de gargalos de acesso a dados;
  • Vivência com ETL, processamento massivo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;

  • Experiência com gerenciamento de transações e concorrência, aplicando padrões para alta disponibilidade;

  • Experiência com Azure SQL Database ou outras plataformas de nuvem;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, SSIS, SSRS e integração com soluções analíticas;

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Support Engineer, you’ll solve complex, high‑impact issues across diverse environments, ensuring seamless product performance and exceptional customer experience. You’ll act as a key link between customers and engineering, driving resolutions, sharing insights, and influencing product improvements. This role offers the opportunity to deepen expertise in Java, distributed systems, and troubleshooting while mentoring others and shaping best practices in a collaborative, fast‑paced environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Diagnose and resolve advanced technical issues across multiple programming languages, build environments, and deployment scenarios;
  • Escalate critical issues to R&D with detailed technical analysis while maintaining transparent customer communication throughout resolution;
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive knowledge base of solutions, workarounds, and best practices;
  • Mentor L1/L2 engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions to elevate team capabilities;

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in customer‑facing technical roles within software organizations;

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills;
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities;
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross‑functional teams;
  • Ability to manage multiple products and technologies simultaneously;
  • Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for staying current with industry trends;
  • Track record of self‑directed learning and adapting to new technical environments.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Hands‑on experience developing Atlassian Server/DC apps using Atlassian SDK and Atlassian Plugin Framework;
  • Experience in scripting languages, including JavaScript, TypeScript, and jQuery;
  • Experience with Maven, Git/Bitbucket, and Bamboo build pipelines;
  • Experience with React, Node, and package managers;
  • Good knowledge of REST API design, JSON, and XML;
  • Good knowledge of Atlassian SAL, Active Objects, event handling, and licensing modules;
  • Comfortable with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and test automation;
  • Strong knowledge of logging frameworks (Log4j2) and dependency injection (Spring).

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.

If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

description:
The Catalyst Group is a tech-focused financial services organization that is creating a spark in a one-dimensional industry. Founded in the Cayman Islands in 2020, Catalyst is a privately owned and fully independent group. We have offices and teams in 5 countries, servicing a global portfolio of clients with a wide range of strategies, structures, and requirements.

Catalyst was founded with a clear mission to reimagine financial services by sparking innovation, harnessing technology, and investing in our people and our communities.

In support of that mission, we have built an award-winning team of highly skilled, innovative, and client-centric individuals that are enabled with best-in-class technology to provide a platform that is unlike anything else in the industry.

We do things differently. We do things better.

Catalyst is a values driven organization. We challenge our people to think and operate in accordance with a set of core values: Collaboration, Innovation, Reliability & Accountability, Connected Culture, Undivided Attention, Integrity, and Transparency. These values are part of our DNA; they are the principles that guide everything that we do.

Required Skills & Experience

  • LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Experience: 7-10 years of legal experience in fund administration, financial services, or a similar regulated industry. Experience in managing legal teams or functions is strongly preferred.
  • Legal Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global regulatory frameworks, legal compliance standards, data protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), and risk management principles.
  • Leadership Skills: Proven track record in leading legal teams, executing strategy, and managing cross-functional projects.
  • Contract Negotiation: Expertise in drafting, negotiating, and managing complex contracts, particularly in the financial services, fund administration, or corporate sectors.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to identify, analyze, and mitigate legal risks while balancing business needs.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to solving complex legal, regulatory, and business challenges.
  • Project Management: Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Technology Skills: Proficiency with legal technology tools, contract management systems, and document management systems.

About this role

As a Manager – Compliance, Legal & Governance (Legal) you will report to the Director, General Legal Counsel, this role is a contract management role focused on production and forms a critical connection between business, clients and their accompanying fund structures. The legal managers is responsible for the accurate, efficient and commercially aligned drafting, structuring and execution of client and vendor agreements across multiple jurisdictions but often with a strong Brazilian investor slant.

The Manager is expected to operate as a contracts engine within the organization, translating business, operational and regulatory requirements into clear, enforceable and appropriately risk-balanced legal templates, with initial supervision.

Based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, the role also provides jurisdictional legal support across corporate, HR, finance and operational functions, ensuring that local and cross-border considerations are appropriately reflected in the company’s group legal and contractual framework.

From a high-level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following categories:

  • Contract Drafting
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Structuring & Legal Coherence
  • Business & Operational Legal Support (Brazil Focus)
  • Legal Operations & Process Efficiency
  • Business Development and Stakeholder Engagement

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:

1. Contract Drafting & Execution (Primary Mandate)

  • Independently draft, review and finalize a high volume of client agreements, administration agreements, NDAs and commercial contracts.
  • Translate inputs from business development teams and Microsoft Dynamics into structured, coherent agreements with fee schedules, referencing:
  • legal entities and party descriptions
  • recitals and background sections
  • defined terms and cross-referencing
  • jurisdiction and governing law provisions
  • Ensure agreements are internally consistent, commercially aligned and execution-ready , requiring minimal rework.
  • Take ownership of the full contract lifecycle , from initial instruction through to execution.
  • Maintain and apply standard templates, playbooks and clause libraries , while adapting them appropriately to specific transactions.

2. Multi-Jurisdictional Structuring & Legal Coherence

  • Ensure correct entity mapping and contracting structures across jurisdictions (Cayman, BVI, Bahamas, Brazil, US and others as applicable).
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies in party roles, service scopes and legal relationships before documents are issued.
  • Align contractual frameworks with the company’s operating model and regulatory positioning (non-regulated vs regulated services, delegation structures, etc.).
  • Populating service fee schedules from Business Development proposal into client agreements.

3. Business & Operational Legal Support (Brazil Focus)

  • Provide day-to-day legal support to finance, HR and operations in Brazil, including:
  • corporate and governance matters
  • employment-related documentation and structuring
  • vendor and service provider arrangements
  • Support internal stakeholders on jurisdiction-specific considerations, including indirect tax sensitivities and local legal requirements.
  • Act as a local legal bridge between Brazil operations and global legal leadership.

4. Legal Operations & Process Efficiency

  • Drive consistency and efficiency in contracting through:
  • playbook development
  • Reduce dependency on external counsel by internalising repeatable legal workstreams.
  • Contribute to building a scalable legal function capable of supporting business growth.

5. Business Development and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage directly with business development, clients and internal teams to clarify instructions and close gaps quickly.
  • Operate with a delivery mindset, ensuring that legal work enables — rather than delays — commercial outcomes.
  • Manage competing priorities and deliver under tight timelines without compromising quality.

description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified IP Docketing Specialist (Analyst) to join our Intellectual Property Law Department. (IPLD)

IPLD are responsible for Company-wide legal support for all IP-related matters, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, IP-related agreements, as well as IP education and counseling.

The Docketing Specialist’s primary role is to maintain and manage the company’s intellectual property docketing system, ensuring accurate records management, including tracking of domestic and international patent and trademark matters.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Manage the company’s intellectual property docketing system for patents, trademarks and related matters.
  • Create, manage, and maintain foreign and domestic intellectual property matters.
  • Assist with portfolio data management, including matter creation, transfers and closures.
  • Monitor communications from outside counsel law firms and docket deadlines and tasks for in-house attorneys and paralegals.
  • Perform quality control audits of docket entries to ensure accuracy, completeness, and data integrity.
  • Generate regular reports for attorneys and management regarding portfolio status, upcoming deadlines, workload metrics and compliance tracking.
  • Learn and understand the company’s IP docketing processes, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of the docketing process.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years professional and relevant patent docketing experience, gained in a major international law firm or major corporate legal department.
  • Experience with patent and trademark prosecution, and foreign patent and trademark databases and websites.
  • Strong writing skills in English, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to effectively prioritize workload.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite including Excel.
  • Thorough knowledge of IP docketing software (Unycom is a plus).
  • Proficiency in communicating in English, both written and spoken.

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí!

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como A marca mais amada do Rio e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a Marca preferida dos Cariocas .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?

Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

A empresa desenvolve soluções de classe mundial para os mercados das organizações de segurança pública e privada e para o setor de Infraestrutura.

Sua Missão

Como Analista de Soluções (com foco em banco de dados), você comporá um time de sustentação de nossas soluções, atendendo a demandas de um cliente específico no mercado de Segurança Pública.

Ajudará a manter nossas soluções com o máximo de disponibilidade possível para o cliente, contribuindo com a melhora dos serviços prestados aos cidadãos em geral no campo da Segurança Pública.

Esta vaga é para atuação híbrida, de segunda-feira a sexta-feira, em horário comercial, trabalhando na base do nosso cliente na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Bairro: Cidade Nova), conforme demanda.

Suas Responsabilidades Incluirão

  • Desenvolver soluções de banco de dados em alta disponibilidade;
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar funções e procedimentos usando T-SQL;
  • Revisar e analisar os requisitos de negócios em andamento;
  • Criar relatórios;
  • Analisar as consultas SQL existentes e sugerir novas para otimizar o desempenho;
  • Criar scripts e procedimentos para migração de dados e oferecer relatórios programados em tempo hábil;
  • Criar processos de transformação e carga de dados (ETL);
  • Atuar como recurso técnico no processo de suporte dos sistemas da Octave no cliente, incluindo também coleta de requisitos, criando soluções para os diversos desafios que o fluxo de trabalho do cliente apresenta, recomendando melhores práticas para tais soluções, bem como apoiar os recursos do cliente no suporte aos sistemas.
  • Atuar no atendimento aos incidentes e solicitações através das plataformas utilizadas pela Octave;
  • Analisar incidentes e propor soluções de contorno (workaround) ou definitivas minimizando impactos aos usuários considerando o SLA proposto;
  • Realizar consultas avançadas no sistema gerenciador de banco de dados do cliente, criando relatórios prontos na solução Octave correspondente, e extraindo relatórios diversos para atender a demandas esporádicas;
  • Auxiliar na identificação da causa raiz de incidentes P1;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias com foco na estabilização do ambiente e redução de incidentes;
  • Criar e atualizar base de conhecimento técnico da equipe;
  • Ocasionalmente, desenvolver componentes customizados para os sistemas das soluções Octave a fim de solucionar demandas do cliente ou soluções de integrações;
  • Fornecer suporte à equipe de pré-vendas, prestando assistência a demonstrações de produtos ao cliente, quando necessário;
  • Ter boa comunicação para interagir com o cliente não apenas em temas técnicos, mas também fazer a gestão de assuntos administrativos e a interface com o setor jurídico da empresa.

Education / Qualifications

Suas habilidades e experiências

  • Formação superior em Engenharia de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou equivalentes;

Octave provides mission‑critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle — Design, Build, Operate and Protect — where performance, safety, and reliability are non‑negotiable and failure is not an option.

Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real‑world conditions and enterprise‑scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most.

Please note: this hybrid position is based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.

At Uber, Frontend Engineers build web experiences that power the way people move and receive things around the world. As part of our engineering team, you'll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users. You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product).

About The Teams

  • Delivery: The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers.
  • ADS: The Ads team builds and scales the advertising platform and its features that power sponsored experiences across Uber's apps, connecting riders, eaters, and advertisers in relevant and measurable ways. The team owns end-to-end ad delivery (from ad creation, rendering, and experimentation to tracking, measurement, and performance optimization) across mobile and web surfaces. The work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and data, ensuring ads are high-quality for users while driving impact for advertisers and Uber's business.
  • Mobility (Rider Core): Millions of people depend on Uber's web application to make ride reservations and get on-demand Uber rides. The Rider Core Team at Uber is redefining what it means to Uber and expanding our products beyond on-demand rides. In this role, you'll work with many distributed teams, ranging from designers, engineers, and data scientists, to provide market-defining products and trip planning experiences over the web.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues.
  • Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems.
  • Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area.
  • Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross-functional project dynamics.

What You'll Need

  • 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications.
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.
  • Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS.
  • Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability.
  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.
  • Familiarity with back-end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full-stack issues.
  • Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production.

Garantir a segurança e saúde dos colaboradores por meio da implementação, fiscalização e orientação de práticas seguras no ambiente de trabalho, identificando e mitigando riscos, promovendo a cultura de prevenção de acidentes e garantindo a conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras.

  • Organizar e conduzir a Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalho (SIPAT) com palestras e atividades educativas.

title: Staff Software Engineer | Credit Cards
description:
About Us

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology‑leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit

About The Role

At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products.

You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability.
  • Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs.
  • Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact.
  • Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks.
  • Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage.

Required Qualifications

  • Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission‑critical, high‑volume, and low‑latency systems in global fintech or e‑commerce environments.
  • Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures.
  • Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups.
  • Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions.
  • History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact.
  • In‑depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages.
  • Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows.
  • Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.

Location & Work Model

This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) .

Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity

At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know.

This offer is conditional on meeting all applicable regulatory eligibility requirements and successful completion of background checks.

description:
About Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a trusted partner in risk assessment, delivering data-driven solutions that help businesses accelerate growth, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer experience.

Our Business Services portfolio supports critical areas such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), Identity Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk Mitigation, and Customer Data Management.

Learn more at risk.lexisnexis.com.

About Our Team

You’ll work within a collaborative and supportive environment to grow your personal and problem-solving skills and help deliver solutions that will go head-to-head against some of the most motivated attackers in the world to protect billions in revenue.

About The Role

Collaborate with customers and account managers to maximize the value of the world’s leading email-based risk assessment solution, driving reduced fraud, lower friction, and increased profitability.

Key responsibilities include proactive account analysis, optimization of risk strategies, and delivering strategic insights during business reviews. The role requires a consultative mindset, strong analytical skills, and a focus on delivering measurable customer value.

You’ll work with real-time digital identity intelligence, analyzing millions of transactions monthly across major players in Financial Services, Insurance, and e-Commerce.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with clients to assess business needs and define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  • Lead project planning, execution, and governance, ensuring timelines, KPIs, and quality standards are met.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by proactively understanding client environments and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Coordinate with Product, Sales, and internal teams to ensure seamless implementation, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct workshops, manage stakeholder communication, and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Share best practices, deliver internal training, and contribute to process optimization within Professional Services.
  • Drive customer success by fostering adoption, monitoring health metrics, and identifying upsell opportunities.
  • Gather client feedback to inform product development and enhance the overall customer experience.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience in payments, fraud, risk management or e-commerce industry.
  • 5+ years of client-facing experience, with a strong focus on risk mitigation strategies.
  • Proven track record in account management, client delivery, and complex project implementations.
  • Strong consultative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in statistics and data forensics.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships and drive customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Experienced in cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, and sales teams.
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset, high integrity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Spanish is a welcomed plus.

Working for You

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

  • Hybrid work system
  • Wellbeing programs
  • Life insurance
  • Health and dental plans
  • RECARES days for supporting charity
  • Access to employee resource groups with volunteer time
  • Access to learning and development resources

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Strategy & Leadership Support

  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.

Institutional Coordination & Governance

  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.

Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)

  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.

Communications & Special Projects

  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

About the Role

Uber for Family was made for family organizers who want to share their payment profile with their loved ones to pay, manage the spending limits and conveniently track their status and ETA when they invite them to join your Family Profile.

Uber for Teens is a customized experience inside Uber for Family exclusive for teenagers. Teen accounts give the teenager the freedom to request their own rides, all under supervision of their guardians. Plus, with live safety features and real-time updates, the guardian can follow along from pickup to drop off.

Joining the team, you will collaborate with the other team members to design, develop, and maintain user interfaces and features for mobile applications (Android).

As a Software Engineer at Uber, you will be a member of Uber’s first Tech Center in Latin America! We are initially focused on sophisticated technologies to improve safety around the world, such as advanced telematics, machine learning, high scale distributed systems, real time data processing and mobile development, among others.

What the Candidate Will Do

  1. Partner with fellow engineers to build and maintain backend services and solutions to support user-facing products, downstream services, or infrastructure tools and platforms used across Uber, millions of Uber riders and drivers worldwide;
  2. Work on Uber's most complex applications by designing, implementing, and unit testing the mobile application code;
  3. Work with Product Managers and Designers to nail user experiences;
  4. Drive ongoing efficiency and reliability improvements through design and automation: availability, performance, scaling, monitoring and capacity;
  5. Lead upstream and downstream dependencies, collaborate with other engineering teams, capture requirements, evolve solutions and enable successful adoption;
  6. Create frameworks and abstractions that are reliable, reusable and avoid surprising outcomes;
  7. Go to person to get clarity of problem statements and also can break down into meaningful tasks;
  8. Promote and demonstrate problem-specific expertise and execution excellence in delivering results.

Basic Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field AND / OR +4-year total technical software engineering experience;
  2. Proficiency in Java and Kotlin, strong knowledge of both programming languages commonly used for Android development;
  3. Experience with Android SDK, strong knowledge of Android's core libraries, tools, and frameworks.
  4. Knowledge of Android UI/UX Design Principles, experience designing responsive and intuitive user interfaces;
  5. Advanced English language skills to work with other engineers and stakeholders from different regions around the world;

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Understanding of Android Architecture Components and other architecture components for building scalable and maintainable apps;
  2. Familiarity with Jetpack libraries to build modern Android apps;
  3. Expertise in using Kotlin Coroutines for managing background tasks and asynchronous code;
  4. Skills in profiling and optimizing apps for performance, including memory management, battery usage, and smooth UI rendering;
  5. In-depth understanding of Android Activity and Fragment lifecycle management, including handling configuration changes and memory leaks;
  6. Experience with Android testing frameworks and familiarity with debugging tools;
  7. Knowledge of performance tuning, usability and automation testing;
  8. Good understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git.

Main responsibilities

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura para atuar de forma estratégica na governança e nos processos de TI, apoiando a condução e o controle de projetos em contextos ágeis e preditivos, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas, qualidade das entregas e previsibilidade de resultados.

Como será o dia a dia:

  • O Gerente de Projetos Sênior é responsável por liderar iniciativas estratégicas e de alta complexidade, garantindo a entrega de resultados aderentes aos padrões técnicos, e de gestão estabelecidos internamente. Suas atribuições incluem:
  • Liderança e Governança de Projetos: Gerenciar projetos corporativos, desde a concepção até o encerramento, assegurando aderência às metodologias internas baseadas no PMBOK e em práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Atuar como principal facilitador entre equipes técnicas, áreas de negócio, fornecedores e stakeholders executivos, promovendo alinhamento contínuo e tomada de decisão eficaz.
  • Planejamento e Controle: Estruturar o plano do projeto, seus artefatos, cronograma, curva S, baseline de custos e mecanismos de controle, atualizando-os conforme a evolução das entregas.
  • Elaborar, defender e comparar cenários envolvendo alternativas técnicas, impactos financeiros, riscos operacionais e benefícios esperados.
  • Planejar e sequenciar atividades, coordenando líderes técnicos e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Monitoramento, Riscos e Indicadores: Monitorar o desempenho físico e financeiro, assegurando a aderência ao baseline e atuando preventivamente sobre desvios.
  • Utilizar com acurácia os sistemas internos para manter controles financeiros atualizados.
  • Identificar, analisar e tratar riscos, propondo ações mitigadoras e acompanhando sua execução.
  • Consolidar informações para geração de status reports executivos periódicos, garantindo comunicação assertiva e tempestiva aos patrocinadores e comitês de governança.
  • Condução de Reuniões e Engajamento de Partes Interessadas: Preparar, conduzir e facilitar reuniões de kickoff, comitês gestores, status reports e encerramento, promovendo clareza, alinhamento e foco em resultados.
  • Gerenciar relacionamentos sensíveis com stakeholders internos e externos, mediando conflitos e garantindo um ambiente colaborativo.
  • Gerenciar projetos de infraestrutura de TI, migrações para cloud, segurança da informação e modernização tecnológica e implementação de sistemas de gestão.
  • Integrar múltiplas disciplinas técnicas (TI, engenharia, segurança operacional, jurídico, suprimentos), garantindo que premissas regulatórias, ambientais e de compliance sejam respeitadas.
  • Acompanhar processos de compras, RFP e BID, especialmente em projetos industriais, logísticos ou regulatórios.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação profissional em TI, Administração e áreas afins.
  • Certificação PMI ou Pós-graduação / especialização em gestão de projetos.
  • Experiência em projetos alinhada as boas práticas do PMBOK.
  • Experiência em projetos de software de média e longa duração e alta complexidade.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de interação com o ambiente de negócios.
  • Experiência avançada com ferramenta MS Project, SAP, Jira, SharePoint.
  • Inglês Intermediário.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

Será um diferencial do profissional domínio destes tipos de entregas:

  • Projetos de Implantação de Sistemas de Terceiros (PPM / Contencioso).
  • Certificação Ágil (Scrum Master e/ou Product Owner).
  • Prática em projetos com times ágeis, preferencialmente times Scrum.
  • Atuação em projetos utilizando a metodologia ágil SCRUM.
  • Projetos de atualização de versão de legado de sistemas e SAP.
  • Migração dos Windows para Azure.
  • Modernização do acesso remoto (vpn, firewall, app. proxy).
  • Migração dos AD's para Azure.
  • Migração demais ambientes do DC T-Systems para Azure.
  • Migração CSP para Global Azure.
  • Interação com o time técnico (desenvolvimento e infraestrutura).

title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team

Who You Are

  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level

Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule

What We Are Offering

  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays

Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

Main responsibilities

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requirements and skills

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.
  • Será um diferencial residir na Zona Norte.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.

  • Salário compatível com o mercado

  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Convênio com faculdades
  • Convênio com farmácias
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Descontos nos nossos produtos em nossa loja online.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
Sobre a Função
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação para integrar nossa equipe global de Group Security. A posição reporta-se ao(à) Líder Global de Antifalsificação (ACF) e tem como objetivo liderar a estratégia regional de combate à falsificação, protegendo nossa marca, nossos consumidores e nossa propriedade intelectual.
Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e com impacto real nos negócios, trabalhando em parceria com equipes internas, autoridades e parceiros externos em diferentes países da região.
Base: Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo
Principais Responsabilidades
Liderança Estratégica

  • Colaborar com áreas internas como negócios, jurídico, assuntos corporativos e comunicação
  • Construir e manter parcerias com autoridades, entidades do setor e stakeholders estratégicos
  • Gerenciar fornecedores de serviços de investigação, promovendo eficiência, inovação e uso responsável do orçamento
  • Definir indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e acompanhar resultados
  • Comunicar avanços e insights de forma clara à liderança e às partes interessadas

Execução Operacional
  • Identificar mercados, produtos e riscos prioritários na região
  • Implementar estratégias regionais de antifalsificação alinhadas aos objetivos globais
  • Supervisionar investigações online e offline realizadas por parceiros externos
  • Desenvolver inteligência sobre tendências, rotas e novos métodos de falsificação
  • Atuar em conjunto com autoridades, alfândega e órgãos reguladores em ações de enforcement
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações internacionais de propriedade intelectual
  • Apoiar iniciativas legais relacionadas à falsificação
  • Gerenciar o orçamento regional do programa de antifalsificação
  • Avaliar resultados e ajustar estratégias quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com equipes de embalagem e negócio na adoção de tecnologias de autenticação de produtos

Engajamento e Desenvolvimento
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores externos de investigação
  • Desenvolver treinamentos regionais sobre riscos e prevenção à falsificação
  • Representar a Haleon em fóruns, eventos e grupos de trabalho do setor
  • Atuar como referência técnica para stakeholders internos na região

Qualificações
  • Experiência sólida (mín. 5 anos) em investigações, proteção de marca, antifalsificação ou enforcement de propriedade intelectual
  • Vivência com autoridades, alfândega e equipes jurídicas em contextos internacionais ou regionais
  • Experiência na gestão de investigações complexas e fornecedores externos
  • Conhecimento em leis de propriedade intelectual e tendências de falsificação
  • Certificações na área são um diferencial
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Ética, resiliência e senso de responsabilidade
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório)

Competências Essenciais
  • Autonomia, organização e tomada de decisão responsável
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma estratégica quanto prática
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders e equipes diversas
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento e fornecedores
  • Mentalidade orientada a risco, aprendizado contínuo e melhoria constante
  • Capacidade de colaborar com pessoas de diferentes culturas, países e realidades

About The Role
As part of a global team within Group Security, the Anti-Counterfeit Regional Investigations Manager reports to the Global Lead for Anti-Counterfeiting (ACF). The main function of the role is to tactically develop and implement the ACF strategy, manage and supervise ACF Program investigations and activities in the designated geographic region to include country specific plans. Responsibilities include intelligence assessment, case selection, the management and oversight of anti-counterfeit investigations (online and offline), proactive investigation case management, to include the development and implementation of innovative approaches and investigative strategies to meet business needs.
The manager will collaborate with internal business stakeholders, law enforcement, legal teams, and external partners to drive enforcement actions and strategic initiatives. The role ensures the protection of the company’s intellectual property, brand integrity, and consumer trust by identifying, investigating, and mitigating counterfeit activities.
Location: Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
  • Develop operational relationships with key internal stakeholders including business, legal, corporate affairs, and corporate communications
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement agencies, industry bodies, regulatory authorities, and peer organizations
  • Build and maintain strategic and tactical investigation service supplier relationships, promoting innovation, responsiveness, cost optimization, return on investment (ROI), and continuous improvement
  • Develop KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and return on investment (ROI)
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders

Operational Execution
  • Conduct risk assessments to identify high-risk markets and products
  • Develop and implement regional anti-counterfeit strategies aligned with global brand protection goals
  • Provide instruction and guidance to external investigation suppliers based on the strategic direction set by the Global Program Lead
  • Provide effective case management oversight and direction by working with external investigation suppliers to ensure investigations are conducted and reported efficiently and in accordance with Haleon’s ACF Program Strategy
  • Develop intelligence strategies to identify and monitor counterfeiting trends
  • Oversee regional monitoring of counterfeit activities across online and offline channels
  • Implement a regional customs strategy to identify key strategic ports and counterfeiting routes, product authentication training opportunities, and intelligence dissemination practices
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, customs, regulatory bodies, and industry coalitions to pursue and, when appropriate attend, enforcement actions
  • Ensure ACF Program compliance with international IP laws and regulations
  • Support litigation efforts related to counterfeit activities
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of counterfeit trends and regulatory changes
  • Manage the regional anti-counterfeit program budget, ensuring effective forecasting, spend control, and ROI
  • Monitor and evaluate enforcement outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly
  • Identify and report counterfeiting developments and techniques which undermine product security
  • Work with packaging design and business teams to evaluate and implement product authentication technologies (e.g., serialization, digital watermarking, blockchain).

Stakeholder Engagement and Training
  • Manage relationships with external investigation service suppliers
  • Develop regional training programs to educate stakeholders on counterfeiting risks and mitigation opportunities
  • Represent Haleon at regional industry forums, conferences and working groups to share intelligence, benchmark practices, and influence standards
  • As a subject matter expert, support a regional network of non-ACF champions embedded across business units and functions

Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in law enforcement investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement
  • Experience of working with law enforcement, customs, and legal teams across international jurisdictions
  • Proven experience in investigating and managing complex proactive investigations and enforcements
  • Demonstrated success in managing third-party investigation service suppliers and operational budgets
  • Professional certification such as Interpol Intellectual Property (IP) Crime College or recognized university anti-counterfeit or intellectual property program accreditation strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of IP laws, counterfeit trends, and enforcement mechanisms
  • Exceptional written/oral communication
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and resilience under pressure

Core Competencies
  • Self-motivated and able to act independently and responsibly demonstrating sound and ethical judgment
  • Ability, at both a strategic and tactical level, to identify and manage ACF related issues and customize, implement, and execute solutions
  • Strong commercial acumen and budget/vendor management experience
  • Risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrate ability to work with a wide range of individuals from diverse backgrounds, countries of origin, and at varying levels within the corporate structure

Job Posting End Date
Equal Opportunities
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
Adjustment or Accommodations Request
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
Note to candidates
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

Na nossa empresa , valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a inovação e o compromisso com a excelência. Se você busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Nossa missão é elevar a vida, cuidando da saúde mental do Brasil.

title: Analista Sênior - GRC
description:
Descrição

O Analista Sênior em GRC (Governança, Risco e Conformidade) é responsável por estruturar, implementar e manter programas corporativos de Segurança da Informação alinhados às melhores práticas e regulamentações vigentes. Atua de forma estratégica e técnica junto às lideranças de negócio e de TI, conduzindo iniciativas de conformidade, gestão de riscos, continuidade de negócios, privacidade de dados e resposta a incidentes, com foco na maturidade do ambiente de SI e na proteção dos ativos de informação da organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Governança de Segurança da Informação

  • Desenvolver, revisar e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Manter e evoluir o Sistema de Gestão de Segurança da Informação (SGSI) conforme ISO/IEC 27001.
  • Apoiar processos de auditoria interna e externa relacionados à SI.
  • Alinhar a governança de TI e SI aos requisitos do COBIT e ITIL.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos de indicadores de GRC para a alta direção.

Gestão de Riscos e Conformidade

  • Conduzir processos de identificação, análise, avaliação e tratamento de riscos de segurança.
  • Realizar assessments periódicos com base em frameworks como CIS Controls, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, 27005, entre outras.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar planos de tratamento de riscos (Risk Register) e controles mitigadores.
  • Assegurar conformidade com regulamentos aplicáveis: LGPD, GDPR, PCI DSS, SOX e normas setoriais.
  • Conduzir due diligences e avaliações de conformidade em fornecedores e parceiros (Third Party Risk Management).

Privacidade de Dados (Privacy by Design)

  • Atuar como referência técnica em projetos de adequação à LGPD e GDPR.
  • Apoiar o DPO/Encarregado na condução de DPIAs (Data Protection Impact Assessment).
  • Manter o inventário de dados pessoais (Data Mapping) e a base legal de tratamento atualizada.
  • Desenvolver programas de conscientização em privacidade para colaboradores.
  • Continuidade de Negócios e Gestão de Crises
  • Elaborar e manter o Plano de Continuidade de Negócios (PCN/BCP) e o Plano de Recuperação de Desastres (DRP) conforme ISO 22301.
  • Coordenar exercícios de teste e simulação de continuidade.
  • Desenvolver e revisar a análise de impacto nos negócios (BIA).

Suporte ao SOC e Resposta a Incidentes

  • Apoiar o CSIRT/SOC na gestão de incidentes de segurança, garantindo conformidade com os processos estabelecidos.
  • Participar da definição e atualização dos playbooks de resposta a incidentes.
  • Conduzir análises pós-incidente (post-mortem/RCA) e emitir relatórios de lições aprendidas.
  • Acompanhar métricas de incidentes de segurança e propor melhorias processuais.
  • Assessments e Auditorias

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


Department: Communications


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy. This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raises awareness on the tournament, influences public perception, engages with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level. Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.


Key Responsibilities



  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.

  • Develop messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.

  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.

  • Develop and implement pre-emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.

  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution withing FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead-up to and during the tournament.

  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.

  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.

  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem.

  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.


Your Profile



  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions

  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)

  • Spanish language skills are an asset

  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year

  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

No dia a dia sua atuação terá quatro pilares:

3. Storytelling e Visualização:

  • Storytelling com Dados: Traduzir dados em narrativas claras e acionáveis para stakeholders de diferentes níveis, focando no "porquê" por trás dos dados;
  • Dashboards Estratégicos: Criar visualizações no Tableau que suportem decisões
  • Realizar apresentações: para times de outras squads como negócios, produto e data para realizar os testes, discutir resultados, alinhar expectativas, prazos e implementar soluções.

  • Agentes de IA: Interesse e aprendizado ativo no uso de Agentes de IA e LLMs.

  • Data Viz & Storytelling: Experiência em criar dashboards e facilidade em apresentações;
  • Noção de Dados: Entendimento de conceitos de ETL, Data Warehouse e estruturas de bases de dados;

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo.
